brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu descended into the tunnels beneath the Western Wall during Yom Kippur celebrations, accompanied by his wife Sara, Shehab Wire reported. The visit was described as more than a routine religious observance by the occupation government's leader.

Netanyahu's remarks during the underground visit carried significance beyond routine holiday commentary, according to the report. The timing and nature of the visit drew attention amid broader tensions surrounding contested religious and historical sites in Jerusalem.

title: Netanyahu visits Western Wall tunnels during Yom Kippur observance
